title: Easy-01 release_commit semantic target is lost before trustworthy target probing
layer: s02 probe pre-loop gating and prompt/contract assembly
symptom: easy-01 now verifies session_bootstrap, reservation_stage, and audit_trace on the stable lane, but release_commit still ends with SP_CommitRelease unknown and emits only calibration-level probe artifacts instead of a target probe or semantic parameter rename.
smallest_reproducer: stable lane 8201 -> 8090, spectrum_release_commit.dll upload run with prior_job_id and cross_dll_prior_job_ids seeded from easy-01 reservation_stage, required_semantic_checkpoint=SP_CommitRelease, selected_invocable_names=[SP_CommitRelease]
trust_impact: easy-01 cannot be promoted to a baseline specimen because the remaining semantic checkpoint is not auditable; the probe layer can appear to complete while never proving whether the target function was skipped, contradicted by prompt guidance, or truly exercised.
allowed_next_actions: emit explicit skip_pre_probe artifacts for cancel, documented, focus, and checkpoint exits

write mcp_schema_t0.json from the runtime-normalized tool schema so the stage-00 contract truth matches the live probe surface
